title: Cancel mascot does not play when a cloud job is Stopped
description: MPI-908 built the job-cancelled mascot: a Stop (activeGenerations.cancel emits generation:cancelled with byUser:true) keeps the gallery placeholder while the op's cancelled clip plays once (MpiGalleryBlock _cancelledPlaceholders, MpiGalleryGrid card setCancelled / cancel-shown). Fabio verified it on a local model; on a cloud model (Flux Pro, DeepInfra) it did not play. Cause not investigated: reproduce, then check whether the cloud Stop reaches activeGenerations.cancel, whether the placeholder is in _myGenIds / grid.el.getGroup at that moment, and which Stop button was used. Spec to extend: tests/desktop/cancelled-mascot.spec.js.
